verdict.rationale: Poly documents its own search: natural-language search inside files down to page or paragraph, a CLI `poly search` command, and folder-scoped search via "Search within...", which roughly covers path filtering. Tags exist and sync with Finder, but nothing shows search filters on tags or properties. Offline search is also undocumented; pinned offline files concern file availability, not search. Missing for 10: tag filters in search, property/metadata filters, offline search capability, evidence of instant/full-text keyword indexing, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can instantly search all my notes with full-text search plus filters on tags, properties, and paths — including offline

citations.quote: Search inside your files with natural language that's gives you results down to the exact timestamp, page, paragraph, or frame.
To search within one folder, right-click it and choose Search within...
poly search "the contract with the March deadline"
